# The well keeps its name

The same dry voice, written in English. Three turns of talk and one explicit
command that must open a flow.

## Turn 1 — author
> The town says the visitor, never the thing. Why does the name make it smaller?

- **Class:** `answer`
- **Offer expected:** no
- **Must not:** open a guided session; answer with a template
- **Why:** rule 2 — a question about craft wins over any command
  (tie-breaker 1)

## Turn 2 — author
> The house at the end of the road has no scene yet. Only the sound of someone
> walking upstairs. Does that carry the dread, or is it just furniture?

- **Class:** `answer`
- **Offer expected:** yes — non-blocking, after the reply
- **Must not:** open a guided session; create a consent token
- **Why:** rule 2 — request for opinion; mentioning the house is not commanding

## Turn 3 — author
> I have three scenes in the well and none of them explains it. I don't know if
> a fourth would help or spend it.

- **Class:** `answer`
- **Offer expected:** no
- **Must not:** open a guided session; treat the uncertainty as first-person
  volition
- **Why:** rule 1 — explicit uncertainty wins over volition (tie-breaker 2)

## Turn 4 — author
> Build the entity a sheet: Vhoros, third person, never fully seen.

- **Class:** `start_flow`
- **Target:** `guided-entity`
- **Explicitness:** `imperative`
- **Must not:** answer with advice only; drop the name Vhoros
- **Why:** rule 5 — explicit imperative with a determinable entity, no
  uncertainty and no question
